text:
maria_cs: kicking off DeltaWave dedicated capacity bring-up — quota set to 1.2M tokens/min baseline. coordinating autoscale and smoke tests today. @ajay_eng @sophie_ops
ajay_eng: ack. plan for burst policy? allow short 3x bursts or keep a stricter cap?
sophie_ops: prefer cautious approach — 2x burst for first 24h, then reassess. need automatic fallback routing to quantized variant if pool saturated.
kevin_oncall: oncall here. I can watch scaling alerts and perform manual rollbacks if things degrade.
li-reliability: recommend pre-populating KV cache for common prefixes to reduce cold-token cost during the smoke run.
maria_cs: good call. test plan: 30m smoke, synthetic ~20 tps, seq length ~1k tokens, target p95 < 350ms, errors < 0.5%. CS will message customer at start/end.
ajay_eng: adding k6 script and load profile to the test bucket now. will spin up canary instance first.
deploy-bot: load-test-job started: id=lw-2469, target=20tps, duration=30m
ajay_eng: insert load script snippet for ops — use this for k6 invocations:
```bash
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 30m --rps 20 smoke-deltawave.js
```
kevin_oncall: alert rule proposal: scale-out when queued_requests > 50 for 2m; scale-in only after 10m steady. also set SLA watcher on p95 latency > 500ms to alert SRE.
sophie_ops: add quota alert at 85% consumption to notify CS and prevent unexpected throttles.
maria_cs: noted. CS will hold a short customer comms window 10m before test and immediately after. capturing customer expectations in case of noisy results.
ajay_eng: runbook items: on OOMs, drain node, restart worker with reduced batch size, fallback to model-v2-quant. tagging run with rollback label.
li-reliability: I'll pre-prime top-100 prefixes using customer's sanitized dataset. maria_cs — need S3 path and permission grant.
maria_cs: will DM S3 path and add your IAM role. also creating a short feedback pulse for customer post-hand-off.
deploy-bot: load-test-job completed: id=lw-2469, peak_tps=22, p95_latency=340ms, errors=0.31%, logs=https://ci.example/deltawave/lw-2469
kevin_oncall: results look within acceptance. will keep an eye for 3h and escalate if error rate creeps.
sophie_ops: scheduling follow-up retro tomorrow 10:00 PT with CS/Eng/SRE to tune autoscale knobs.
maria_cs: thanks team :tada: I'll update the onboarding checklist and mark renewal-risk = low for now. capturing notes in the handoff doc and tagging in the customer record.
